title: September Social Security payment worth $994 goes out in 3 days
text:
The September 2026 Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994, will be sent to recipients in three days.

SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month. If the first day falls on a weekend or federal holiday, the payment is sent on the last business day of the previous month instead.
